'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023–present)|Middle Eastern crisis]]
**[[Israel–Hamas war]]
***[[2023 Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip]]
****[[Siege of Gaza City]]
*****The [[Israel Defense Forces]] announce the complete encirclement of [[Gaza City]] and say that they have split the [[Gaza Strip]] in two after [[Israeli Ground Forces|Israeli troops]] reach the coast. ***The [[Royal Jordanian Air Force]] [[airdrop]]s medical aid to a [[field hospital]] inside the Gaza Strip. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/jordanian-air-force-airdrops-urgent-aid-for-gaza-strip/3044922 (AA)]
**[[2024 Iran–Israel conflict]], [[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)]]
***Three children and a woman are killed, and several others are injured, when two [[Ambulance|ambulances]] carrying [[civilian]]s are hit by an [[Israel]]i [[airstrike]] near the towns of [[Ainata]] and [[Aitaroun]], [[Lebanon]], and four paramedics are injured when two ambulances are bombed in [[Tayr Harfa]]. 
***In response to Israeli airstrikes, [[Hezbollah]] launches an [[anti-tank guided missile]] towards [[Kiryat Shmona]], killing a civilian and shoots down an Israeli [[Elbit Hermes 450]] drone over [[Nabatieh]].[https://www.news9live.com/videos/world-videos/hezbollah-shoots-down-israeli-drone-in-nabatieh-region-2341533 (News9Live)] 
***Three Hezbollah members are retaliationally killed in a series of Israeli airstrikes. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20231105-lebanon-says-israeli-strike-kills-reporter-s-4-relatives (AFP via France 24)] [https://www.timesofisrael.com/israeli-civilian-killed-in-anti-tank-missile-attack-from-lebanon-amid-escalation/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Battle of Khartoum (2023–2025)|Battle of Khartoum]]
***At least 20 people are killed by [[Shell (projectile)|shells]] that hit a [[marketplace]] in [[Khartoum]]. [https://www.voanews.com/a/more-than-20-killed-in-sudan-after-shell-hits-market-ngo/7343082.html (AFP via VOA)]

**Eleven people are killed and several more are [[Kidnapping|kidnapped]] as [[Boko Haram]] gunmen [[mass shooting|open fire]] against [[farmer]]s working in their [[Field (agriculture)|fields]] in [[Jere, Nigeria|Jere]], [[Borno State]], [[Nigeria]]. [https://apnews.com/article/boko-haram-borno-farmers-northeast-food-a9a719ed7e39b0e38ba26ece091fca1d (AP)]

'''Disasters and incidents'''
*A car crashes into a [[beer garden]] in [[Daylesford, Victoria|Daylesford]], [[Victoria (state)|Victoria]], [[Australia]], killing five people and injuring four others. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2023-11-05/daylesford-crash-victoria-police-five-dead-royal-hotel/103067290 (ABC News)]

'''Health and environment'''
*The [[Government of Delhi]], [[India]], extends school closures for an additional week due to persistent high [[Air pollution in India|air pollution]] levels, with provisions for [[Education in India#Secondary Education|secondary schools]] to opt for [[Distance education|online classes]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20231105-smog-ridden-new-delhi-extends-schools-shutdown (AFP via France 24)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2023 Hamburg Airport hostage incident]]
**A man drives onto the tarmac at [[Hamburg Airport]] in [[Germany]] and holds his four-year-old daughter [[hostage]] underneath an airplane, causing all flights at the airport to be suspended. The man surrenders to police 18 hours later. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-67326185 (BBC News)]
*[[Israel–Hamas war protests]]
**Pro-Palestinian protestors clash with police and attempt to overrun the [[United States Air Force|USAF]] occupying [[Incirlik Air Base]] in [[Turkey]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20231105-turkish-police-tear-gas-pro-palestinian-protesters-at-air-base (France24)]
*A radio broadcaster is fatally shot in [[Calamba, Misamis Occidental]], [[Philippines]], while hosting a broadcast that was also being livestreamed on [[Facebook]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/philippine-radio-anchor-fatally-shot-facebook-livestream-watched-104639928 (AP via ABC News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*The [[Republican People's Party]], [[Turkey]]'s main [[Opposition (politics)|opposition]] [[List of political parties in Turkey|party]], elects [[Manisa (electoral district)|Manisa]] [[Grand National Assembly of Turkey|MP]] [[Özgür Özel]] as its new [[List of the Main Opposition Leaders of Turkey|leader]] following the party's loss in the recent [[2023 Turkish parliamentary election|parliamentary election]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/turkeys-main-opposition-elects-ozgur-ozel-new-leader-run-up-local-elections-2023-11-05/ (Reuters)]

'''Sports'''

**In [[baseball]], the [[Hanshin Tigers]] defeat the [[Orix Buffaloes]] to win the [[Japan Series]] in seven games, capturing their second championship and their first since [[1985 Japan Series|1985]]. [https://japannews.yomiuri.co.jp/sports/baseball/20231105-147833/ (Japan News)]

**In [[auto racing]], [[Ryan Blaney]] of [[Team Penske]] wins his first [[NASCAR]] [[NASCAR Cup Series|Cup Series]] championship. *[[2023 New York City Marathon]]
